# Appendix 2 {#sec-appendix-2}

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: tbl-duncan
#| tbl-cap: "Critical values $r_p (p, df, \\alpha = 0.05)$ for Duncan's multiple range tests."
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# Convert math delimiters so MathJax reliably renders math inside kable
# table cells and headers: $$...$$ becomes \[...\] and $...$ becomes \(...\).
fix_math <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- ""
  x <- gsub("\\$\\$(.+?)\\$\\$", "\\\\[\\1\\\\]", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\$([^$]+)\\$", "\\\\(\\1\\\\)", x, perl = TRUE)
  x
}

dt <- read.csv("csv/duncan.csv", check.names = FALSE)
dt[["df"]][dt[["df"]] == "Inf"] <- "$\\infty$"
colnames(dt)[1] <- "$df \\backslash p$"

dt[] <- lapply(dt, fix_math)
colnames(dt) <- fix_math(colnames(dt))

kbl(dt, escape = FALSE, booktabs = FALSE, align = "c") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = F, html_font = "Cambria") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "repeat_header"),
                font_size = 11) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```
